So 2.5 rounds to 2, 3.5 rounds to 4 and -2.5 rounds to -2.  This is the mode used for tax, discounts and proration. Where a tax amount is shared over several lines, or a discount or account credit is split, the parts are made to add up to the total exactly (largest remainder first, ties to the earlier line).  ## Other modes  Callers can pass a mode explicitly:  | Mode | 2.5 | 3.5 | 2.4 | -2.5 | |---|---|---|---|---| | `half-even` (default) | 2 | 4 | 2 | -2 | | `half-up` | 3 | 4 | 2 | -3 | | `down` | 2 | 3 | 2 | -2 |  ## Sign  Rounding is symmetric. The result for a negative value is always the negative of the result for the same positive value, so a credit rounds the same way as the charge it reverses.
